admission.justification: Compatibility must omit genuinely absent optional display blocks without weakening the current producer contract or using an impossible consumer-authored fixture.

applicability: A current native TaskEntry/TaskSummary payload missing optional display fields.
conditions: An absent whole review state omits its block/count without error.
The mounted fixture uses current native optional-field absence; retained historical recordings are provenance, not current old-build compatibility execution.
exclusions: Making current producer review counts optional.
Declaring negative recorded age values a permanent normative guarantee.

statement: A current native task-entry reader draws an addressed entry whose optional task-summary display fields are absent without their dependent Review block, finding count, status note or header notes and without an error. Historical old-build envelopes retain provenance but do not establish wire compatibility with the removed parallel projection collections.
